requirements.description: User wants the building to be located near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user requires an energy class of D or better, so all classes from A1 down to D are accepted. Gross floor area, capacity for 45 people, and proximity to green spaces are not among the available columns and were not translated into filters.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 45 people, the energy class requirement (D or better), and the proximity to green spaces are not gross-area constraints or reference columns, so they are not converted into filters here. Turin is a city rather than a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set; location is handled by the Location Agent.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property_type 'Attività scolastiche' (the filterable equivalent of tipologia_bene_immobile), surface_area >= 600, energy_class in A1–D, green >= 74, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. The 45-person capacity from the user query was not in the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered on.
